chunks: And in it, that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except over those who follow him.
And He granted him authority over those who follow him from mankind and jinn.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this teaching within the Shia doctrine of *al-wilayah al-takwiniyyah* (cosmic dominion), clarifying that Satan's power is not inherent but derived from the believer's voluntary submission to his whispers. This conditional authority underscores the theological principle that *nafs* (the self) and *jinn* are co-agents in this dynamic, emphasizing human free will (*ikhtiyar*) over deterministic predestination.
